policy: This file is optimization-decision data, not task-card/base facts. Protected quests are hard deletion blockers for later P-tier pruning unless the user explicitly requests a re-audit or deletion of the protected quest/package. A package may either preserve its old P label or explicitly remove the quest from P1-P4 candidate ranking when the user declares it structurally non-removable.
